known_limitations_and_nonclaims: RB1 is not complete SWAP 4.3.1 functionality.
RB1 does not qualify all physical options.
RB1 does not establish universal MODFLOW coupling accuracy.
RB1 does not qualify RossFast for production.
RB1 is not Status A or Status AA certification.
RB1 makes no universal performance superiority, absolute runtime SLA, portable peak-RSS or representative difficult-column p50/p95/p99 claim.
Surface-evaporation functional MultiSWAP compatibility is qualified; broader throughput/scaling remains a separate performance workunit and does not reopen RB1 science.
RB1 is not validation for every application domain.

canonical_relationship.rule: SWAP5-RB1-v1 is an immutable historical release authority. Later integration/f-ci-canonical development never changes RB1.
canonical_relationship.future_release_rule: A later release must state its relationship to RB1, enumerate source/reference/scope deltas and requalify its own candidate.

handoffs.F-DOC01_F-DOC02: May consume this authority for Status-A-ready traceability and documentation, but may not reinterpret RB1 as Status A/AA or reopen its science.
handoffs.F-TB01_F-TB03: May adopt bounded RB1 release fragments into permanent testbank/release-bank governance without changing frozen RB1 source, oracle, scope or scientific authority.

publication.note: The repository connector available to this workunit does not expose tag/release creation. Exact-head branch authority plus green CI is therefore the authoritative in-repository freeze; a later tag may point to this exact metadata-authority commit without changing RB1.
